series.name: T-REX 25/30/40/50 KHP3G01 three-phase hybrid inverter
series.notes: Three-phase commercial hybrid. Warning table = codes 01-22 (17 not used), unit keeps running. Fault table = codes 01-94, output is cut. Codes 80-86, 89, 90, 95 are not present in the printed table. Parallel CAN comms codes (87/88) and BMS comms codes (92/93) only appear on units fitted with the parallel/BMS option. Do NOT merge with Series 8 (T-REX-10KLP3G01) - different table, different numbering.

meaning.en: Battery 1 pack voltage is above the BMS cut-off point. Inverter keeps running but the battery should be discharged.
meaning.ur: Battery 1 ka voltage BMS cut-off se upar hai. Inverter chalta rahega lekin battery discharge karni chahiye.

causes.en: Battery SOC too high after a long float charge with PV input
causes.ur: PV se lambi float charging ke baad battery ka SOC bohat zyada ho gaya

causes.en: Battery 1 BMS calibration value out of date on firmware
causes.ur: Battery 1 ki BMS calibration value firmware mein purani hai

causes.en: Battery 1 module cell imbalance
causes.ur: Battery 1 module ke cells mein imbalance hai

solutions.en: Read battery 1 voltage on the LCD BMS page and compare with the module datasheet max charge voltage.
solutions.ur: LCD ke BMS page par battery 1 ka voltage dekhein aur module datasheet ke max charge voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: Stop PV charging and let the battery discharge to about 80% SOC before restarting.
solutions.ur: PV charging band karein aur battery ko 80% SOC tak discharge hone dein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: If the code returns with PV off, update the inverter and BMS firmware, then re-commission the battery type in the app.
solutions.ur: PV band karne par bhi code aaye to inverter aur BMS firmware update karein, phir app mein battery type dobara configure karein.

meaning.en: Battery 2 pack voltage is too high; the battery should be discharged.
meaning.ur: Battery 2 ka voltage bohat zyada hai, battery ko discharge karna chahiye.

causes.en: Battery 2 SOC high while PV is still charging
causes.ur: PV charging chal rahi hai aur Battery 2 ka SOC already high hai

causes.en: Battery 2 relay welded so the pack cannot be isolated
causes.ur: Battery 2 ka relay weld ho gaya hai, pack isolate nahi ho raha

causes.en: Wrong battery chemistry selected (lead-acid configured for a lithium pack)
causes.ur: Galat battery chemistry set hai (lithium pack par lead-acid configure kiya gaya)

solutions.en: Check battery 2 voltage on the LCD BMS page against the pack maximum charge voltage.
solutions.ur: LCD BMS page par battery 2 ka voltage aur pack ke max charge voltage ko compare karein.

solutions.en: Switch off PV input at the DC isolator and let battery 2 discharge before switching back on.
solutions.ur: DC isolator se PV input band karein aur battery 2 ko discharge hone dein, phir wapas on karein.

solutions.en: Verify battery type in the app/lCD setup; set it to match the actual lithium pack.
solutions.ur: App ya LCD setup mein battery type check karein aur usay actual lithium pack ke mutabiq set karein.

meaning.en: Battery 1 voltage is too low; the battery should be charged.
meaning.ur: Battery 1 ka voltage bohat kam hai, battery ko charge karna chahiye.

causes.en: Battery deeply discharged after a long load-shedding outage
causes.ur: Load shedding lambi rahegi to battery gehri tarah discharge ho gaya

causes.en: PV array not producing (dust, shading, wrong MPPT voltage)
causes.ur: PV se power nahi aa rahi (dhool, shadow, MPPT voltage galat)

causes.en: Battery 1 pre-charge relay or fuse open
causes.ur: Battery 1 ka pre-charge relay ya fuse khula hai

solutions.en: Check battery 1 pack voltage with a multimeter at the DC terminals; confirm it is above the BMS wake-up threshold.
solutions.ur: DC terminals par multimeter se battery 1 ka voltage check karein aur dekhein ke woh BMS wake-up threshold se upar hai.

solutions.en: Measure PV open-circuit voltage and MPPT current; clean panels and remove shading if generation is low.
solutions.ur: PV ka open-circuit voltage aur MPPT current measure karein; generation kam ho to panels saaf karein aur shadow hatayein.

solutions.en: Inspect the battery 1 fuse and pre-charge relay, then restart the inverter once the pack voltage recovers.
solutions.ur: Battery 1 ka fuse aur pre-charge relay check karein, phir voltage recover hone par inverter restart karein.

meaning.en: Battery 2 voltage is too low; the battery should be charged.
meaning.ur: Battery 2 ka voltage bohat kam hai, battery ko charge karna chahiye.

causes.en: Battery 2 idle while battery 1 carries the whole house load
causes.ur: Battery 2 idle hai aur poora load Battery 1 par chal raha hai

causes.en: Imbalance between the two battery parallel circuits
causes.ur: Dono battery parallel circuits mein imbalance hai

causes.en: Battery 2 fuse open or BMS of pack 2 in sleep
causes.ur: Battery 2 ka fuse khula hai ya pack 2 ka BMS sleep mein hai

solutions.en: Measure battery 2 voltage at its own DC terminals and compare with battery 1.
solutions.ur: Battery 2 ke apne DC terminals par voltage measure karke battery 1 se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check battery 2 fuse rating and the pack 2 BMS wake signal; reseat the pack communication cable.
solutions.ur: Battery 2 ka fuse rating aur pack 2 ka BMS wake signal check karein; pack communication cable dobara lagaein.

solutions.en: Confirm both packs are the same model and same SOC before putting them back in parallel.
solutions.ur: Parallel mein wapas lagane se pehle dono packs same model aur same SOC ke hon ka check karein.

meaning.en: Battery 1 state of charge is too low; the battery should be charged.
meaning.ur: Battery 1 ka SOC bohat kam hai, battery ko charge karna chahiye.

causes.en: Sustained backup discharge with no grid and no solar
causes.ur: Grid aur solar dono na hone par lamba backup discharge chal raha hai

causes.en: Battery capacity faded so usable SOC window is small
causes.ur: Battery ki capacity degrade ho gayi, usable SOC window kam ho gaya

causes.en: SOC calibration drift after a partial charge/discharge cycle
causes.ur: Partial charge/discharge ke baad SOC calibration drift ho gayi

solutions.en: Read SOC on the LCD and compare with the measured pack voltage; a mismatch means SOC needs recalibrating.
solutions.ur: LCD par SOC dekhein aur pack voltage se compare karein; mismatch ho to SOC dobara calibrate karna hoga.

solutions.en: Give the pack one full uninterrupted charge from PV or grid until charge stage is complete.
solutions.ur: PV ya grid se pack ko ek poora uninterrupted charge dein jab tak charge stage complete na ho.

solutions.en: If SOC reads low immediately after a full charge, test battery capacity with a load tester.
solutions.ur: Poori charging ke foran baad SOC low dikhe to battery capacity ko load tester se test karein.

meaning.en: Battery 2 state of charge is too low; the battery should be charged.
meaning.ur: Battery 2 ka SOC bohat kam hai, battery ko charge karna chahiye.

causes.en: Battery 2 not taking charge because its BMS is in sleep
causes.ur: Battery 2 charge nahi le raha kyunke uska BMS sleep mein hai

causes.en: Charge current set to 0 A for battery 2
causes.ur: Battery 2 ke liye charge current 0 A par set hai

causes.en: Battery 2 pack communication intermittent
causes.ur: Battery 2 ka pack communication intermittent hai

solutions.en: Check battery 2 charge current limit in the LCD setup and raise it to the pack maximum.
solutions.ur: LCD setup mein battery 2 ka charge current limit check karke pack ke maximum tak barha dein.

solutions.en: Reseat and re-terminate the battery 2 CAN communication cable at both ends.
solutions.ur: Battery 2 ke CAN communication cable ko dono sifar se nikal kar dobara tight karein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle the pack 2 breaker, then confirm the inverter shows the pack 2 SOC on the BMS page.
solutions.ur: Pack 2 ka breaker off/on karein, phir dekhein ke inverter BMS page par pack 2 ka SOC dikha raha hai.

title.ur: Warning 07 High voltage ride-through chal raha hai

meaning.en: Grid voltage dip handling: the inverter sends reactive power to the grid instead of tripping.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage girne par inverter trip hone ke bajaye grid ko reactive power bhejta hai.

causes.en: Grid voltage dipped inside the HVRT curve during a motor start
causes.ur: Motor start hote waqt grid voltage HVRT curve ke andar gir gaya

causes.en: Long AC cable from grid to inverter raising voltage drop
causes.ur: Grid se inverter tak lamba AC cable hone ki wajah se voltage gir raha hai

causes.en: Grid transformer tap on a high position
causes.ur: Grid ka transformer tap high position par hai

solutions.en: This is a normal ride-through behaviour; confirm the inverter returns to normal after the dip.
solutions.ur: Yeh normal ride-through behaviour hai; confirm karein ke dip ke baad inverter normal par aa jata hai.

solutions.en: Log grid voltage with a clamp meter during the event to see how deep the dip goes.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se event ke dauran grid voltage log karein ke dip kitna gehra hai.

solutions.en: If trips follow, check grid voltage at the inverter terminals, not at the utility meter.
solutions.ur: Agar uske baad trip ho to grid voltage inverter terminals par check karein, utility meter par nahi.

title.ur: Warning 08 Low voltage ride-through chal raha hai

meaning.en: Grid voltage swell handling: the inverter absorbs reactive power from the grid rather than tripping.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage barhne par inverter trip ke bajaye grid se reactive power le leta hai.

causes.en: Grid over-voltage event from a large local load being shed
causes.ur: Bohat bara local load drop hone se grid par over-voltage event

causes.en: Weak grid with high fault level and long feeder
causes.ur: Kamzor grid, high fault level aur lamba feeder

causes.en: Grid standard set to a country with a wider ride-through window
causes.ur: Grid standard aise desh ka set hai jiski ride-through window barhi hai

solutions.en: Confirm the unit returns to normal once grid voltage is back in range.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke grid voltage range mein aate hi unit normal par aa jata hai.

solutions.en: Check the grid standard selection in setup; pick the standard that matches the local DISCO/NEPRA feeder.
solutions.ur: Setup mein grid standard check karein aur woh chune jo local feeder ke mutabiq ho.

solutions.en: Verify the smart meter and CT direction if the unit keeps bouncing between states.
solutions.ur: Agar unit states ke darmiyan oscillate karta rahe to smart meter aur CT ki direction check karein.

meaning.en: Grid frequency is too low, so the inverter reduces its output power.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency bohat kam hai, is liye inverter apni output power kam kar raha hai.

causes.en: Large generator or weak grid pulling frequency down
causes.ur: Bara generator ya kamzor grid frequency neeche kheench raha hai

causes.en: Oversized PV array on a weak single-phase feeder
causes.ur: Kamzor single-phase feeder par bara PV array lagaya gaya

solutions.en: Measure grid frequency with a clamp meter; it should sit near 50 Hz in Pakistan.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se grid frequency measure karein; Pakistan mein yeh 50 Hz ke qareeb hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Reduce PV array size or add energy limiting so the inverter stops pushing power onto a weak grid.
solutions.ur: PV array ka size kam karein ya energy limiting lagayein taake kamzor grid par inverter zyada power na de.

solutions.en: Check generator governor settings if the site runs on a generator.
solutions.ur: Agar site generator par chalti hai to generator ke governor settings check karein.

meaning.en: Grid frequency is too high, so the inverter reduces its output power.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency bohat zyada hai, is liye inverter apni output power kam kar raha hai.

causes.en: Oversized generator running at light load
causes.ur: Bara generator halki load par chal raha hai

causes.en: Frequency-based load shedding setting in the app
causes.ur: App mein frequency based load shedding ka setting

solutions.en: Measure grid frequency; on a generator, set the generator governor to 50 Hz.
solutions.ur: Grid frequency measure karein; generator par governor ko 50 Hz par set karein.

solutions.en: Switch off non-essential loads so the generator is not running far below its rated output.
solutions.ur: Ghair zaroori loads band karein taake generator rated output se bohat neeche na chale.

title.ur: Warning 11 Low frequency par power barhana

meaning.en: Grid frequency is low, so the inverter increases its output to support the grid.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency kam hai, is liye inverter grid ki madad ke liye output barhata hai.

causes.en: Weak grid dragging frequency down
causes.ur: Kamzor grid frequency neeche kheench rahi hai

causes.en: Frequency support function enabled on a grid that cannot take it
causes.ur: Aise grid par frequency support function on hai jo isko handle nahi kar sakta

solutions.en: Confirm the unit is on grid (not EPS) and frequency support is intentionally enabled.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke unit grid par hai (EPS par nahi) aur frequency support jaanbujh kar on hai.

solutions.en: Log frequency with a clamp meter; if it stays below 49.5 Hz the feeder is overloaded.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se frequency log karein; agar 49.5 Hz se neeche rehta hai to feeder overloaded hai.

solutions.en: Reduce PV export limit or stagger large motor loads if frequency support trips the unit.
solutions.ur: Agar frequency support unit ko trip kar raha hai to PV export limit kam karein ya bare motor loads stagger karein.

meaning.en: Output load is above the inverter rating; the load should be reduced.
meaning.ur: Output load inverter ki rating se zyada hai, load kam karna chahiye.

causes.en: Air conditioner or water pump compressor starting while other loads run
causes.ur: Doosre loads chalte waqt AC ya water pump ka compressor start hona

causes.en: Motor surge current on starting (3-7x rated)
causes.ur: Motor ka starting surge current rated ka 3-7 guna

causes.en: Load steps not configured, so the inverter cannot shed them
causes.ur: Load steps configure nahi hain, is liye inverter unhein shed nahi kar sakta

solutions.en: Read the load percentage on the LCD and list the connected loads to find the biggest consumer.
solutions.ur: LCD par load percentage dekhein aur sab loads list karke sabse bara consumer dhoondein.

solutions.en: Stagger motor starts using the load-step / stagger function in the app so peaks do not overlap.
solutions.ur: App mein load-step ya stagger function on karein taake motor starts aik ke baad aik na hon.

solutions.en: Size the inverter for the largest motor's surge current, not just its running wattage.
solutions.ur: Inverter ko sirf motor ki running wattage se nahi, balki uske surge current se size karein.

meaning.en: The DC-side lightning protector has tripped; the inverter keeps working but the PV side is unprotected.
meaning.ur: DC side ka lightning protector trigger ho gaya hai; inverter chalta hai lekin PV side ab protected nahi.

causes.en: Direct or induced lightning strike on the PV array or DC cable
causes.ur: PV array ya DC cable par direct ya induced lightning strike

causes.en: DC SPD spent its life after repeated small surges
causes.ur: Baar baar chhote surges ke baad DC SPD ki life khatam ho gayi

solutions.en: Check the DC SPD status window on the LCD and inspect the module for a blown fuse element.
solutions.ur: LCD par DC SPD status window dekhein aur module mein fuse element toota ya nahi check karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV at the DC isolator, then replace the DC SPD module with the same type and voltage rating.
solutions.ur: DC isolator se PV disconnect karein, phir DC SPD module ko wahi type aur rating wali se replace karein.

solutions.en: Earth the PV array frame and the SPD earth lead properly; a floating earth makes the SPD useless.
solutions.ur: PV array frame aur SPD ki earth lead ko theek se earth karein; earth floating ho to SPD bekaar hai.

meaning.en: The AC-side lightning protector has tripped; check the protector itself.
meaning.ur: AC side ka lightning protector trigger ho gaya hai; protector khud check karein.

causes.en: Surge coming from the grid side during a storm
causes.ur: Storm ke dauran grid side se surge aana

causes.en: AC SPD at end of life
causes.ur: AC SPD ki life khatam ho gayi

solutions.en: Inspect the AC SPD indicator window and confirm the AC SPD earth cable is tight to the busbar.
solutions.ur: AC SPD indicator window dekhein aur AC SPD ki earth cable busbar par tight hai ya nahi confirm karein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC at the main breaker, then replace the AC SPD cartridge.
solutions.ur: Main breaker se AC isolate karein, phir AC SPD cartridge replace karein.

solutions.en: Add surge protection on the grid incoming breaker as well, not only at the inverter.
solutions.ur: Sirf inverter par nahi, grid incoming breaker par bhi surge protection lagayein.

meaning.en: Radiator (heat sink) temperature is too high, so the inverter reduces its output power.
meaning.ur: Radiator ka temperature bohat zyada hai, is liye inverter output power kam kar raha hai.

causes.en: Dust packed on the heat sink fins blocking airflow
causes.ur: Heat sink ki fins par dhool ki tabaal se airflow ruki hui hai

causes.en: Ambient temperature above 45 C in a shaded but unventilated store room
causes.ur: Bina ventilation wale kamre mein ambient temperature 45 C se upar

causes.en: Fan failed or running slow
causes.ur: Fan kharab ho gaya ya dheere chal raha hai

solutions.en: Power off, let the unit cool, then clean the heat sink with a soft dry brush and a vacuum.
solutions.ur: Unit off karein, thanda hone dein, phir heat sink ko soft dry brush aur vacuum se saaf karein.

solutions.en: Check the fan spins freely by hand and confirm its connector is seated on the board.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke fan haath se azaad ghoomta hai aur uska connector board par baitha hua hai.

solutions.en: Ensure at least the manufacturer's clearance around the unit and keep the intake free of wall dust and paint.
solutions.ur: Manufacturer ki clearance unit ke aarpaar rakhein aur intake ko deewar ki dhool se paak rakhein.

meaning.en: Ambient air temperature is too high, so the inverter reduces its output power.
meaning.ur: Hawa ka temperature bohat zyada hai, is liye inverter output power kam kar raha hai.

causes.en: Direct afternoon sun on the inverter cabinet
causes.ur: Inverter cabinet par seedha dopahar ki dhoop lag rahi hai

causes.en: Unit installed inside a closed room with no cross ventilation
causes.ur: Unit band kamre mein lagi hai jahan cross ventilation nahi hai

causes.en: Hot air from an adjacent generator or battery room recirculating
causes.ur: Paas ke generator ya battery room se garm hawa wapas aa rahi hai

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature at the unit vents with a thermometer; it must be within the datasheet range.
solutions.ur: Thermometer se unit ke vents par ambient temperature measure karein; woh datasheet ke range mein hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Install a sun shade above the unit and keep at least 30 cm clear on all sides.
solutions.ur: Unit ke upar dhoop ki chhaan lagayein aur charon taraf kam az kam 30 cm saaf rakhein.

solutions.en: Add forced ventilation or move the unit out of the closed room if temperature stays high.
solutions.ur: Temperature high rehta hai to forced ventilation lagayein ya unit ko band kamre se bahar nikaalein.

meaning.en: Fan 1 has stopped working; check the fan wiring.
meaning.ur: Fan 1 kaam nahi kar raha; fan wiring check karein.

causes.en: Fan connector loose on the control board
causes.ur: Control board par fan connector dhila hai

causes.en: Fan bearing seized after dust and heat
causes.ur: Dhool aur garmi se fan ka bearing jam ho gaya

causes.en: Fan 12 V supply rail low
causes.ur: Fan ki 12 V supply rail kam ho gayi

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the fan connector on the board.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karein, phir board par fan connector dobara baitha dein.

solutions.en: Spin the fan by hand; if it is stiff or scrapes, replace the fan with the same size and voltage.
solutions.ur: Fan ko haath se ghumayein; agar sakht ho ya sarkh raha ho to wahi size aur voltage ka fan lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure 12 V at the fan header while the unit is running; below 11 V means the auxiliary supply is weak.
solutions.ur: Unit chalte waqt fan header par 12 V measure karein; 11 V se kam ho to auxiliary supply kamzor hai.

meaning.en: Fan 2 has stopped working; check the fan wiring.
meaning.ur: Fan 2 kaam nahi kar raha; fan wiring check karein.

causes.en: Fan 2 connector loose or fan 2 bearing seized
causes.ur: Fan 2 ka connector dhila hai ya bearing jam ho gayi

causes.en: Fan 2 cable pinched during installation
causes.ur: Installation ke dauran fan 2 ka cable nichal gaya

solutions.en: Open the unit safely and reseat the fan 2 connector.
solutions.ur: Unit ko mehfooz tareeqe se kholein aur fan 2 ka connector dobara laga dein.

solutions.en: Replace fan 2 if it does not spin freely on the bench.
solutions.ur: Bench par fan 2 azaad na ghoome to use replace kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the fan 2 cable for pinching along its route and free it.
solutions.ur: Fan 2 ki cable ke poore raste par pinching check karke azaad karein.

meaning.en: Fan 3 has stopped working; check the fan wiring.
meaning.ur: Fan 3 kaam nahi kar raha; fan wiring check karein.

causes.en: Fan 3 cable disconnected during a previous fan replacement
causes.ur: Pichli fan replacement ke dauran fan 3 ka cable nikal diya gaya

causes.en: Fan 3 motor open circuit
causes.ur: Fan 3 ka motor open circuit ho gaya

solutions.en: Continuity-check the fan 3 winding with a multimeter; an open reading means the fan is dead.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se fan 3 ki winding ka continuity check karein; open reading aaye to fan kharab hai.

solutions.en: Reseat the fan 3 plug and confirm fan 3 spins when the inverter commands cooling.
solutions.ur: Fan 3 ka plug dohara laga dein aur cooling command par fan 3 ghoomta hai ya nahi confirm karein.

solutions.en: Replace fan 3 with an identical 12 V DC fan of the same frame size.
solutions.ur: Fan 3 ko wahi 12 V DC fan, same frame size, se replace karein.

meaning.en: Fan 4 has stopped working; check the fan wiring.
meaning.ur: Fan 4 kaam nahi kar raha; fan wiring check karein.

causes.en: Fan 4 connector loose
causes.ur: Fan 4 ka connector dhila hai

causes.en: Fan 4 blade fouled by packing material left after installation
causes.ur: Installation ke baad packing material fan 4 ki blade mein phansi hui hai

solutions.en: Remove any packing material or cable tie touching the fan 4 blade.
solutions.ur: Fan 4 ki blade ko chhu raha koi packing material ya cable tie nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Test fan 4 for continuity and free spinning, then reseat its connector.
solutions.ur: Fan 4 ki continuity aur azaad ghoomne ka test karein, phir connector dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Replace fan 4 if the motor is open.
solutions.ur: Motor open ho to fan 4 replace kar dein.

meaning.en: The internal fan has stopped working; check the internal fan wiring.
meaning.ur: Internal fan kaam nahi kar raha; internal fan wiring check karein.

causes.en: Internal fan blocked by dust inside the cabinet
causes.ur: Cabinet ke andar dhool se internal fan block ho gaya

causes.en: Internal fan harness chafed against a heatsink edge
causes.ur: Internal fan ka harness heatsink ke kinare se ragad gaya

solutions.en: Vacuum the inside of the cabinet and free the internal fan impeller.
solutions.ur: Cabinet ke andar vacuum karein aur internal fan ki impeller azaad karein.

solutions.en: Inspect the internal fan harness for chafing and re-route it away from sharp edges.
solutions.ur: Internal fan ke harness mein ragad ki nishaniyan dekhein aur use sharp edges se door re-route karein.

solutions.en: Replace the internal fan with the same voltage and size if it is open circuit.
solutions.ur: Internal fan open circuit ho to wahi voltage aur size ka fan lagayein.

meaning.en: PV1 string voltage is above the MPPT window; output is cut.
meaning.ur: PV1 string ka voltage MPPT window se upar hai; output band ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Too many modules in series for the ambient temperature
causes.ur: Ambient temperature ke liye series mein modules zyada hain

causes.en: Grid code set to a higher max PV voltage than the array
causes.ur: Grid code array se zyada max PV voltage par set hai

causes.en: Very cold morning with clear sky and no load on the inverter
causes.ur: Bard subah, saaf aasman aur inverter par load nahi

solutions.en: Measure PV1 open-circuit voltage with a meter and compare it with the MPPT upper limit in the manual.
solutions.ur: Meter se PV1 ka open-circuit voltage measure karke manual ke MPPT upper limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: Remove one module from the string, or enable soft limit for PV voltage in the setup.
solutions.ur: String se ek module nikaalein, ya setup mein PV voltage ka soft limit on karein.

solutions.en: Check that no MPPT is configured for a string that is not connected.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke koi MPPT aise string par set na ho jo connected hi nahi hai.

meaning.en: PV1 string current is too large; check the string current.
meaning.ur: PV1 string ka current bohat zyada hai; string current check karein.

causes.en: Strings with different module ratings paralleled on one MPPT
causes.ur: Ek MPPT par alag ratings ke modules ke strings parallel hue hain

causes.en: Module degradation causing current mismatch between parallel strings
causes.ur: Module degrade hone se parallel strings ke darmiyan current mismatch

causes.en: Insulation fault on the string creating a leakage path
causes.ur: String par insulation fault jo leakage path bana raha hai

solutions.en: Use a clamp meter on the PV1 string and compare it with the module Isc and the inverter max input current.
solutions.ur: PV1 string par clamp meter lagayein aur use module ke Isc aur inverter ke max input current se compare karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the parallel strings one at a time and measure each separately to find the odd string.
solutions.ur: Parallel strings ko aik aik kar ke disconnect karke har ko alag alag measure karein taake galat string mil jaye.

solutions.en: Check PV string insulation to earth with a megohmmeter at the inverter's own test voltage.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke apne test voltage par megohmmeter se PV string ki earth insulation check karein.

title.ur: Fault 09 PV1 polarity ulat di hui

meaning.en: PV1 string positive and negative are swapped; check the string wiring.
meaning.ur: PV1 string ke positive aur negative aik doosre ke sath badal diye hain; string wiring check karein.

causes.en: String connector wired in reverse during installation
causes.ur: Installation ke dauran string connector ulat kar lagaya gaya

causes.en: Module ribbon reconnected backwards on one module
causes.ur: Ek module par ribbon ulat kar dobara lagaya gaya

solutions.en: Isolate PV at the DC isolator, then confirm polarity with a DC voltmeter across the string before reconnecting.
solutions.ur: DC isolator se PV isolate karein, phir dobara lagane se pehle DC voltmeter se string ke across polarity confirm karein.

solutions.en: Trace the string from the last module back to the isolator and correct the reversed connector.
solutions.ur: String ko aakhri module se DC isolator tak trace karke ulat hua connector theek karein.

solutions.en: Re-check polarity with the meter after the fix; only then close the DC isolator.
solutions.ur: Theek karne ke baad dobara meter se polarity check karein; tabhi DC isolator band karein.

meaning.en: Battery 1 voltage is too high; the battery should be discharged.
meaning.ur: Battery 1 ka voltage bohat zyada hai; battery discharge karni chahiye.

causes.en: BMS cut-off voltage set lower than the inverter charge limit
causes.ur: BMS ka cut-off voltage inverter ke charge limit se neeche set hai

causes.en: Charge current too high for the pack so terminal voltage overshoots
causes.ur: Pack ke liye charge current zyada hai, terminal voltage over shoot kar gayi

causes.en: Battery 1 cell imbalance in a multi-module pack
causes.ur: Multi-module pack mein battery 1 ke cells mein imbalance

solutions.en: Compare the BMS over-voltage cut-off with the inverter battery charge voltage in the setup and align them.
solutions.ur: BMS ka over-voltage cut-off inverter setup ke battery charge voltage se compare karke aik jaisa karein.

solutions.en: Measure battery 1 terminal voltage with a meter; if it is above the pack limit, stop charging at the DC isolator.
solutions.ur: Meter se battery 1 ka terminal voltage measure karein; pack limit se upar ho to DC isolator se charging rok dein.

solutions.en: Check the cell-level BMS report for a weak cell and rebalance before returning the pack to service.
solutions.ur: BMS ke cell-level report mein kamzor cell dekhein aur pack wapas chalane se pehle balance karayein.

meaning.en: Battery 1 voltage is too high; the battery should be discharged.
meaning.ur: Battery 1 ka voltage bohat zyada hai; battery discharge karni chahiye.

causes.en: Grid charging with the battery already at full SOC
causes.ur: Battery pehle se hi full SOC par ho aur grid se charging chal rahi hai

causes.en: Battery temperature sensor reading low so the charger does not step down
causes.ur: Battery temperature sensor kam dikha raha hai is liye charger power kam nahi karta

causes.en: Two battery strings connected with different cell counts
causes.ur: Do battery strings alag alag cell count ke saath lagi hain

solutions.en: Isolate the battery, measure its open-circuit voltage and compare with the pack's maximum charge voltage.
solutions.ur: Battery isolate karke uska open-circuit voltage measure karein aur pack ke max charge voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: Verify the battery temperature sensor reading against a contact thermometer at the pack.
solutions.ur: Pack par contact thermometer lagakar battery temperature sensor ki reading verify karein.

solutions.en: Confirm both battery strings have the same model, same cell count and same SOC before re-paralleling.
solutions.ur: Dobara parallel karne se pehle confirm karein ke dono battery strings ka model, cell count aur SOC aik jaisa hai.

meaning.en: Battery 1 voltage is too low; the battery should be charged.
meaning.ur: Battery 1 ka voltage bohat kam hai; battery charge karni chahiye.

causes.en: Battery deeply discharged and PV/grid not available to recharge
causes.ur: Battery gehri tarah discharge ho gayi aur PV/grid recharge ke liye available nahi

causes.en: Cell imbalance in the pack so the weakest cell pulls the string down
causes.ur: Pack mein cell imbalance, sabse kamzor cell string ko neeche kheench leta hai

causes.en: Battery 1 pre-charge resistor or relay open
causes.ur: Battery 1 ka pre-charge resistor ya relay khula hai

solutions.en: Isolate everything and measure battery 1 open-circuit voltage; below the BMS minimum the pack needs bench charging.
solutions.ur: Sab isolate karke battery 1 ka open-circuit voltage measure karein; BMS minimum se kam ho to pack ko bench par charge karein.

solutions.en: Check the pre-charge relay and fuse on the battery 1 branch with a continuity meter.
solutions.ur: Battery 1 branch ke pre-charge relay aur fuse ko continuity meter se check karein.

solutions.en: Read the cell voltages from the BMS app to find the weak cell before reinstalling the pack.
solutions.ur: BMS app se cell voltages padhein aur pack dobara lagane se pehle kamzor cell dhoondein.

meaning.en: Battery 1 current is too large; check the battery charge and discharge power.
meaning.ur: Battery 1 ka current bohat zyada hai; battery ki charge aur discharge power check karein.

causes.en: Battery charge/discharge current limit set above the pack rating
causes.ur: Battery charge/discharge current limit pack rating se zyada set hai

causes.en: Short circuit in the battery cable or a wrongly wired auxiliary supply
causes.ur: Battery cable mein short ya ghalat tareeqe se wire ki hui auxiliary supply

causes.en: Load surge on the EPS output while the battery is already at max current
causes.ur: Battery pehle se max current par ho aur EPS output par load surge

solutions.en: Set the battery charge and discharge current in the setup to the pack's rated maximum or below.
solutions.ur: Setup mein battery charge aur discharge current ko pack ke rated maximum ya us se kam par set karein.

solutions.en: Isolate the battery and megohmmeter-test the cable insulation to earth before reconnecting anything.
solutions.ur: Battery isolate karke cable ki earth insulation megohmmeter se test karein, kuch bhi wapas lagane se pehle.

solutions.en: Measure the actual current with a clamp meter and compare it with the inverter's battery rated current.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se actual current measure karke inverter ke battery rated current se compare karein.

title.ur: Fault 24 Battery 1 polarity ulat di hui

meaning.en: Battery 1 positive and negative poles are reversed; check the battery wiring.
meaning.ur: Battery 1 ke positive aur negative pole aik doosre ke sath badal diye hain; battery wiring check karein.

causes.en: Battery cable connected backwards on the inverter side
causes.ur: Inverter side par battery cable ulat kar lagaya gaya

causes.en: Pack 1 and pack 2 cables crossed during parallel wiring
causes.ur: Parallel wiring ke dauran pack 1 aur pack 2 ke cables aik doosre ke saath cross ho gaye

solutions.en: Open the battery isolator and confirm polarity with a DC voltmeter across the inverter battery terminals.
solutions.ur: Battery isolator kholein aur inverter ke battery terminals ke across DC voltmeter se polarity confirm karein.

solutions.en: Swap the two battery cables and re-tighten with the correct torque.
solutions.ur: Do battery cables aik doosre se badal dein aur sahi torque par dobara tighten karein.

solutions.en: Check the whole parallel bank for crossed cables before closing the isolator again.
solutions.ur: Isolator dobara band karne se pehle poore parallel bank mein crossed cables check karein.

title.ur: Fault 26 Battery 1 ka relay open circuit

meaning.en: Battery 1 relay is not closing properly, causing an open circuit; shut down and restart.
meaning.ur: Battery 1 ka relay theek se close nahi ho raha, open circuit ho raha hai; band karke restart karein.

causes.en: Battery relay coil or contacts burnt
causes.ur: Battery relay ki coil ya contacts jal gaye

causes.en: Relay control voltage missing because of a blown drive on the board
causes.ur: Board par drive jalne se relay control voltage nahi mil raha

causes.en: Relay mechanically jammed by foreign matter
causes.ur: Relay meinforeign matter ghus kar mechanically jam ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then open the unit and visually inspect the battery 1 relay.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karein, phir unit kholkar battery 1 ka relay aankh se dekhein.

solutions.en: Measure continuity across the relay contacts; a permanently open reading means replace the relay.
solutions.ur: Relay contacts ke across continuity measure karein; hamesha open reading aaye to relay replace karein.

solutions.en: Replace the relay with the exact part number and rating from the Felicity service spares list.
solutions.ur: Relay ko Felicity service spares list wale exact part number aur rating se replace karein.

meaning.en: Battery 1 relay is not opening properly, causing a short circuit; shut down and restart.
meaning.ur: Battery 1 ka relay theek se open nahi ho raha, short circuit ho raha hai; band karke restart karein.

causes.en: Relay contacts welded shut from an overcurrent event
causes.ur: Overcurrent event se relay ke contacts weld ho kar band ho gaye

causes.en: Fuse rating too high so the relay took the full short-circuit current
causes.ur: Fuse rating zyada hai, is liye relay ne poora short-circuit current jhela

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery first, then confirm the battery 1 relay is open with a meter.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC, PV aur battery isolate karein, phir meter se confirm karein ke battery 1 ka relay open hai.

solutions.en: Replace the welded relay and the branch fuse together, using the specified fuse rating.
solutions.ur: Weld ho chuke relay aur branch fuse dono saath replace karein, wahi rating use karte hue.

solutions.en: Find the root cause (battery polarity or insulation) before re-energising, or the new relay will weld too.
solutions.ur: Wapas chalu karne se pehle asal wajah (battery polarity ya insulation) dhoondein, warna naya relay bhi weld ho jayega.

meaning.en: Battery 1 fails to raise its input voltage normally at startup; shut down and restart.
meaning.ur: Battery 1 startup par apna input voltage normally nahi barha pata; band karke restart karein.

causes.en: Battery 1 voltage below the DC-DC soft-start threshold
causes.ur: Battery 1 ka voltage DC-DC soft-start threshold se neeche hai

causes.en: DC-DC pre-charge capacitor not charging
causes.ur: DC-DC ka pre-charge capacitor charge nahi ho raha

causes.en: Heavy output load connected before the soft-start finishes
causes.ur: Soft start khatam hone se pehle he(output load laga diya gaya

solutions.en: Switch the output load off completely, then restart the inverter with no load attached.
solutions.ur: Output load poori tarah band karein, phir koi load na hone par inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Measure battery 1 voltage and confirm it is above the soft-start threshold in the manual.
solutions.ur: Battery 1 ka voltage measure karke confirm karein ke woh manual ke soft-start threshold se upar hai.

solutions.en: If the code returns with no load, have the DC-DC stage and its pre-charge circuit checked at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Bina load ke bhi code aaye to DC-DC stage aur uski pre-charge circuit service centre par check karwayein.

meaning.en: Battery 1 SOC is too low; the battery should be charged.
meaning.ur: Battery 1 ka SOC bohat kam hai; battery ko charge karna chahiye.

causes.en: Extended backup discharge with no PV and no grid
causes.ur: Bina PV aur bina grid ke lamba backup discharge

causes.en: PV not generating because of shading or a blown PV fuse
causes.ur: Shadow ya phootay hue PV fuse ki wajah se PV se power nahi aa raha

causes.en: Battery capacity degraded so it reaches the SOC floor early
causes.ur: Battery ki capacity degrade ho gayi, is liye SOC floor jaldi aa jata hai

solutions.en: Check the SOC and battery voltage on the LCD BMS page, then check grid availability and PV breaker state.
solutions.ur: LCD BMS page par SOC aur battery voltage dekhein, phir grid availability aur PV breaker ka status check karein.

solutions.en: Restore charging: close the PV DC isolator and charge from grid or PV until SOC is above 30%.
solutions.ur: Charging wapas karein: PV DC isolator band karein aur grid ya PV se SOC 30% se upar aane tak charge karein.

solutions.en: If SOC jumps back up but the battery dies quickly, test pack capacity with a load tester and check cell balance.
solutions.ur: SOC wapas upar aa jaye lekin battery jaldi khatam ho jaye to pack capacity load tester se test karein aur cell balance dekhein.

meaning.en: The DC bus voltage is too high; shut down and restart.
meaning.ur: DC bus ka voltage bohat zyada hai; band karke restart karein.

causes.en: Bus voltage spike during grid outage while PV is still feeding the unit
causes.ur: Grid jaane ke waqt PV unit ko feed kar raha tha aur bus par spike aaya

causes.en: Feedback from an AC surge through the anti-islanding path
causes.ur: Anti-islanding path ke zariye AC surge se feedback

causes.en: Bus voltage sensing circuit fault reporting a false high
causes.ur: Bus voltage sensing circuit ki kharabi se jhooti high reading

solutions.en: Do one clean restart as the manual instructs, then watch whether code 35 comes back.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq aik saaf restart karein, phir dekhein ke code 35 dobara aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Check the PV input voltage at the DC terminals; an over-voltage string drives the bus high.
solutions.ur: DC terminals par PV input voltage check karein; over-voltage string bus ko high le jati hai.

solutions.en: If code 35 returns repeatedly, check the AC SPD and the anti-islanding relay wiring.
solutions.ur: Code 35 baar baar aaye to AC SPD aur anti-islanding relay ki wiring check karein.

meaning.en: Bus voltage is too high; shut down and restart.
meaning.ur: Bus ka voltage bohat zyada hai; band karke restart karein.

causes.en: AC surge or internal component failure
causes.ur: AC surge ya internal component ki failure

causes.en: Grid voltage well above the configured limit during an outage
causes.ur: Grid outage ke dauran voltage configured limit se kaafi upar

solutions.en: Restart once as the manual says; if it returns, isolate AC, PV and battery before opening the unit.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq aik baar restart karein; wapas aaye to unit kholne se pehle AC, PV aur battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage at the inverter AC terminals with a meter during the event.
solutions.ur: Event ke dauran meter se inverter ke AC terminals par grid voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Check the AC SPD condition and the anti-islanding relay contacts for pitting.
solutions.ur: AC SPD ki halat aur anti-islanding relay ke contacts ki pitting check karein.

meaning.en: Bus voltage is too low; shut down and restart.
meaning.ur: Bus ka voltage bohat kam hai; band karke restart karein.

causes.en: Battery too weak to charge the bus at startup
causes.ur: Battery itni kamzor hai ke startup par bus charge nahi kar pata

causes.en: Bus voltage sensing fault giving a false low reading
causes.ur: Bus voltage sensing ki kharabi se jhooti low reading

causes.en: Internal component failure in the bus circuit
causes.ur: Bus circuit mein internal component ki failure

solutions.en: Confirm battery SOC and voltage on the LCD before restarting; charge the battery if SOC is very low.
solutions.ur: Restart se pehle LCD par battery ka SOC aur voltage confirm karein; SOC bohat kam ho to battery charge karein.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage under load with a clamp meter and a meter; a big drop points to a weak pack or long thin cable.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter aur meter se load ke under battery voltage measure karein; bara girna kamzor pack ya lamba patla cable batata hai.

solutions.en: Inspect battery cable terminals for corrosion and re-torque them to the specified value.
solutions.ur: Battery cable terminals mein corrosion dekhein aur unhein specified value par dobara torque karein.

aliases: Positive and negative bus imbalance fault

title.ur: Fault 38 Positive aur negative bus ka imbalance

meaning.en: Positive bus voltage does not match the negative bus voltage; shut down and restart.
meaning.ur: Positive bus voltage negative bus voltage ke barabar nahi hai; band karke restart karein.

causes.en: Half-bridge device failure on the inverter board
causes.ur: Inverter board par half-bridge device ki failure

causes.en: Bus voltage sensing on one rail drifted out of calibration
causes.ur: Aik rail ka bus voltage sensing calibration se bahar chala gaya

causes.en: Damaged snubber capacitor letting DC ripple through
causes.ur: Kharab snubber capacitor DC ripple chalne de raha hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then inspect the board for burnt components or bulging capacitors.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karein, phir board par jalay huay components ya phoolay capacitors dekhein.

solutions.en: Return the unit to the authorised service centre for bus rail voltage measurement and calibration.
solutions.ur: Bus rail voltage measurement aur calibration ke liye unit authorised service centre wapas karein.

solutions.en: Do not power the unit repeatedly; repeated attempts can damage the second bridge.
solutions.ur: Unit ko baar baar chalu na karein; repeated se doosra bridge kharab ho sakta hai.

meaning.en: Bus voltage fails to rise normally at startup; shut down and restart.
meaning.ur: Startup par bus voltage normally nahi barh raha; band karke restart karein.

causes.en: Bus pre-charge circuit open so the capacitors never charge
causes.ur: Bus pre-charge circuit khula hai, is liye capacitors charge hi nahi hote

causes.en: DC input or battery voltage too low to start the boost stage
causes.ur: DC input ya battery voltage boost stage start karne ke liye bohat kam hai

causes.en: Grid-relay contact failure leaving the bus tied to grid
causes.ur: Grid relay contact ki failure jis se bus grid seAttached reh jata hai

solutions.en: Measure PV and battery voltage first; both must be above the inverter's minimum start voltage.
solutions.ur: Pehle PV aur battery voltage measure karein; dono inverter ke minimum start voltage se upar hone chahiye.

solutions.en: Isolate the unit and have the pre-charge resistor and the grid relay contacts tested.
solutions.ur: Unit isolate karke pre-charge resistor aur grid relay ke contacts test karwayein.

solutions.en: If the pre-charge path is healthy, the boost stage is likely faulty and needs board-level service.
solutions.ur: Pre-charge path theek ho to boost stage kharab hone ki zyada himmat hai aur board-level service chahiye.

meaning.en: Bus short circuit; shut down and restart.
meaning.ur: Bus mein short circuit hai; band karke restart karein.

causes.en: Inverter power stage device failed short
causes.ur: Inverter power stage ka device short ho kar kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Capacitor on the bus failed short
causes.ur: Bus ka capacitor short ho kar kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Insulation breakdown from moisture ingress
causes.ur: Nami aane se insulation breakdown

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery immediately and do not power the unit again.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery foran isolate karein aur unit dobara chalu na karein.

solutions.en: At the service centre, megohmmeter-test the DC bus to earth before energising anything.
solutions.ur: Service centre par kuch bhi chalu karne se pehle DC bus ki earth insulation megohmmeter se test karein.

solutions.en: Replace the failed device or capacitor bank, then recalibrate and test under load.
solutions.ur: Kharab device ya capacitor bank replace karein, phir calibrate karke load ke under test karein.

meaning.en: Inverter voltage fails to rise normally at startup; shut down and restart.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka voltage startup par normally nahi barh raha; band karke restart karein.

causes.en: Output overloaded or short circuited at switch-on
causes.ur: Switch on karte waqt output overloaded ya short circuited

causes.en: Anti-islanding relay or grid relay not switching cleanly
causes.ur: Anti-islanding relay ya grid relay saaf switch nahi ho raha

causes.en: Inverter bridge device degraded
causes.ur: Inverter ka bridge device degrade ho gaya

solutions.en: Disconnect all output loads and restart; this is the first check every time.
solutions.ur: Saare output loads disconnect karke restart karein; yeh har baar ka pehla check hai.

solutions.en: With loads off, measure the AC output voltage; a missing or distorted waveform points to the bridge.
solutions.ur: Load hatane ke baad AC output voltage measure karein; waveform missing ya bigda hua ho to bridge kharab hai.

solutions.en: If it fails with no load, book the unit for inverter stage repair at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Bina load ke bhi fail ho to unit ko service centre par inverter stage repair ke liye bhejein.

meaning.en: Inverter current is too high; check the supplied power and load size.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka current bohat zyada hai; di gayi power aur load size check karein.

causes.en: Load surge beyond the inverter rating on the EPS output
causes.ur: EPS output par inverter rating se zyada load surge

causes.en: Load step configuration causing several large loads to start together
causes.ur: Load step configuration ki wajah se kai bare loads aik saath start ho rahe hain

causes.en: Inverter current sensor reading high, giving a false trip
causes.ur: Inverter current sensor zyada reading kar raha hai, jis se jhooti trip ho rahi hai

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load one circuit at a time and note which circuit causes the trip.
solutions.ur: Connected load ko aik aik circuit karke kam karein aur note karein ke kaunsa circuit trip karata hai.

solutions.en: Set load steps in the app so heavy loads start in sequence, not simultaneously.
solutions.ur: App mein load steps set karein taake bare loads aik saath nahi, sequence mein start hon.

solutions.en: Check the inverter current sensor reading against a clamp meter; a mismatch means sensor calibration.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se inverter current sensor ki reading compare karein; mismatch ho to sensor calibration karni hai.

meaning.en: Short circuit at the inverter output; shut down and restart.
meaning.ur: Inverter output par short circuit hai; band karke restart karein.

causes.en: Damaged appliance or cable insulation on the backup/EPS distribution board
causes.ur: Backup ya EPS distribution board par koi appliance ya cable ki insulation kharab

causes.en: Water ingress into an outdoor socket or junction box
causes.ur: Outdoor socket ya junction box mein paani chal aaya

causes.en: Inverter bridge device failed short
causes.ur: Inverter ka bridge device short ho kar kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then disconnect the backup distribution board output one circuit at a time.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karein, phir backup distribution board ka output aik aik circuit karke disconnect karein.

solutions.en: With the inverter isolated, test each circuit for continuity to earth to find the shorted cable.
solutions.ur: Inverter isolate karke har circuit ki earth ke saath continuity test karke short wala cable dhoondein.

solutions.en: Inspect outdoor sockets and junction boxes for water and replace any with a cracked faceplate.
solutions.ur: Outdoor sockets aur junction boxes mein paani dekhein aur cracked faceplate wale replace karein.

title.en: Fault 50 Inverter current DC component high
title.ur: Fault 50 Inverter current DC component zyada

meaning.en: The DC component of the inverter current is too high; shut down and restart.
meaning.ur: Inverter current ka DC component bohat zyada hai; band karke restart karein.

causes.en: Output capacitor on the inverter stage degraded
causes.ur: Inverter stage ka output capacitor degrade ho gaya

causes.en: Grid voltage waveform heavily distorted by large non-linear loads
causes.ur: Bare non-linear loads se grid voltage waveform kaafi bigad gaya

causes.en: Current sensing drift after a surge event
causes.ur: Surge event ke baad current sensing drift ho gayi

solutions.en: Measure the AC output waveform with a power meter or oscilloscope and check the DC offset.
solutions.ur: Power meter ya oscilloscope se AC output waveform measure karke DC offset check karein.

solutions.en: Move large non-linear loads (air conditioners, welders) onto a separate supply and retest.
solutions.ur: Bare non-linear loads (AC, welding machine) alag supply par move karke dobara test karein.

solutions.en: Have the output capacitors and current sensor calibration checked at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Service centre par output capacitors aur current sensor calibration check karwayein.

meaning.en: Grid voltage is above the permitted window; check that grid voltage is normal.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage allowed range se upar hai; check karein ke grid voltage normal hai.

causes.en: Utility supply voltage high, common on a lightly loaded long feeder
causes.ur: Utility supply ka voltage high, halki load wale lamba feeder par aam baat hai

causes.en: Grid code window set wider than the local utility tolerance
causes.ur: Grid code ka window local utility tolerance se barhi set hai

causes.en: Generator in voltage boost mode supplying the inverter
causes.ur: Generator voltage boost mode mein chal raha hai aur inverter ko supply kar raha hai

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage at the inverter terminals, not at the utility meter, and log it for 10 minutes.
solutions.ur: Inverter terminals par (utility meter par nahi) grid voltage measure karke 10 minute log karein.

solutions.en: Select the correct grid standard in the setup so the window matches the local feeder.
solutions.ur: Setup mein sahi grid standard chunein taake window local feeder ke mutabiq ho.

solutions.en: If running on a generator, disable voltage boost or reduce generator size to match the load.
solutions.ur: Generator par chal rahe hon to voltage boost band karein ya generator ka size load ke mutabiq kam karein.

meaning.en: Grid voltage is below the permitted window; check that grid voltage is normal.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage allowed range se neeche hai; check karein ke grid voltage normal hai.

causes.en: Long, thin AC cable from grid to inverter causing voltage drop
causes.ur: Grid se inverter tak lamba aur patla AC cable jis se voltage girta hai

causes.en: Loose AC terminal heating up and adding resistance
causes.ur: AC terminal dhila ho kar garam ho raha hai aur resistance barh gaya

causes.en: Weak utility supply during a high-demand period
causes.ur: Bari demand ke waqt utility supply kamzor

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage at the breaker and again at the inverter terminals; the difference is cable drop.
solutions.ur: Breaker par aur phir inverter terminals par grid voltage measure karein; farq cable drop hai.

solutions.en: Re-torque all AC grid terminals and check for heat discolouration on the terminal block.
solutions.ur: Saare AC grid terminals dobara torque karein aur terminal block par garmi ke rang dekhein.

solutions.en: Use a thicker AC cable or shorten the run if the measured drop is more than about 5 percent.
solutions.ur: Measured drop 5 percent se zyada ho to thicker AC cable lagayein ya run chhota karein.

title.ur: Fault 55 Grid phase sequence ulat hui

meaning.en: Grid phase sequence is reversed; check the phase sequence wiring.
meaning.ur: Grid ka phase sequence ulat hua hai; phase sequence wiring check karein.

causes.en: Two phases swapped in the grid connection at the inverter end
causes.ur: Inverter ke sath grid connection mein do phases aik doosre ki jagah lage hain

causes.en: Phase sequence wrong at the utility supply itself
causes.ur: Utility supply par hi phase sequence ghalat hai

solutions.en: Isolate the grid connection and confirm phase sequence with a phase sequence meter.
solutions.ur: Grid connection isolate karke phase sequence meter se sequence confirm karein.

solutions.en: Swap the two incorrect phases at the inverter AC terminal and retighten to torque.
solutions.ur: Inverter AC terminal par do ghalat phases badal dein aur torque par dobara tighten karein.

solutions.en: Verify the phase sequence at the utility incoming point if the inverter still reports code 55.
solutions.ur: Inverter phir bhi code 55 de to utility incoming point par phase sequence verify karein.

meaning.en: The inverter has detected it is islanded and shut down to protect itself and the repair crew.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne detect kar liya ke woh island par chal raha hai aur apni protection ke liye band ho gaya.

causes.en: Grid outage while the inverter was running
causes.ur: Inverter chalte waqt grid chala gaya

causes.en: Grid breaker opened upstream by the utility
causes.ur: Utility ne upstream grid breaker khol diya

causes.en: Anti-islanding relay false detection on a weak grid
causes.ur: Kamzor grid par anti-islanding relay ka jhoota detect

solutions.en: Check the utility supply; when grid returns the inverter should reconnect automatically.
solutions.ur: Utility supply check karein; grid aate hi inverter khud reconnect ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If grid is present and stable, inspect the anti-islanding relay contacts and the voltage sensing wiring.
solutions.ur: Grid mojood aur stable ho to anti-islanding relay ke contacts aur voltage sensing wiring dekhein.

solutions.en: Do not bridge or defeat the anti-islanding function; it is a safety requirement.
solutions.ur: Anti-islanding function ko bypass ya disable na karein; yeh safety requirement hai.

meaning.en: The three-phase grid voltage is unbalanced; check the three-phase voltage.
meaning.ur: Three-phase grid voltage unbalanced hai; three-phase voltage check karein.

causes.en: Single-phase loads heavily concentrated on one phase
causes.ur: Aik phase par single-phase loads ka bohat zyada load

causes.en: One phase conductor loose, high resistance or damaged
causes.ur: Aik phase ka conductor dhila, high resistance ya kharab

causes.en: Utility supply with poor phase balance
causes.ur: Phase balance kharab wali utility supply

solutions.en: Measure all three phase voltages and currents with a clamp meter and note the imbalance.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se teenon phase ke voltage aur current measure karke imbalance note karein.

solutions.en: Re-balance the household load across L1, L2 and L3 so no phase carries more than about a third.
solutions.ur: Ghar ka load L1, L2, L3 par aik se teesai se zyada na ho, is tarah balance karein.

solutions.en: Torque and megger-test all three phase conductors; a loose neutral makes imbalance look worse.
solutions.ur: Teenon phase conductors torque karein aur megger se test karein; neutral dhila ho to imbalance barh dikhta hai.

meaning.en: Load exceeds 110 percent of rated output; the load should be reduced.
meaning.ur: Load rated output ke 110 percent se zyada hai; load kam karna chahiye.

causes.en: Air conditioner compressors plus water pump running together at peak
causes.ur: Peak par air conditioner ke compressors aur water pump aik saath chal rahe hain

causes.en: Load steps not configured
causes.ur: Load steps configure nahi hain

solutions.en: Read the load percentage on the LCD and shed one large circuit.
solutions.ur: LCD par load percentage dekhein aur aik bara circuit band karein.

solutions.en: Configure load steps in the app to shed low-priority circuits automatically.
solutions.ur: App mein load steps configure karein taake low-priority circuits khud-ba-khud shed hon.

solutions.en: Size the inverter for the measured peak demand, not the sum of nameplate ratings.
solutions.ur: Inverter ko nameplate ke jamaat ke bajaye measured peak demand ke mutabiq size karein.

meaning.en: Load exceeds 150 percent of rated output; the load should be reduced.
meaning.ur: Load rated output ke 150 percent se zyada hai; load kam karna chahiye.

causes.en: Motor starting surge far above the inverter rating
causes.ur: Motor ka starting surge inverter rating se kaafi upar

causes.en: Inverter deliberately oversized load already tolerated once, now added more
causes.ur: Inverter ne pehle bohat zyada load tolerate kiya tha, ab aur load lag gaya

solutions.en: Disconnect the biggest load and restart.
solutions.ur: Sabse bara load disconnect karke restart karein.

solutions.en: Use a soft starter or frequency drive on large motors to cut starting current.
solutions.ur: Bare motors par soft starter ya frequency drive lagayein taake starting current kam ho.

solutions.en: Upgrade to a larger inverter if the measured demand genuinely exceeds this model.
solutions.ur: Agar measured demand sach mein is model se zyada hai to bara inverter lagayein.

meaning.en: The emergency power-off input has been triggered; the inverter has shut down.
meaning.ur: Emergency power-off input trigger ho gaya hai; inverter band ho gaya hai.

causes.en: EPO push-button pressed
causes.ur: EPO push button daba diya gaya

causes.en: EPO wiring broken so the inverter reads the loop as open
causes.ur: EPO wiring toot gayi, is liye inverter loop ko open padhta hai

causes.en: EPO dry contact stuck closed from a burnt relay
causes.ur: Jalay huay relay ki wajah se EPO dry contact stuck closed

solutions.en: Reset the EPO push-button and confirm the EPO LED on the inverter turns off.
solutions.ur: EPO push button reset karein aur confirm karein ke inverter ka EPO LED band ho gaya.

solutions.en: Measure the EPO loop continuity with the button released; the loop should be closed.
solutions.ur: Button chhod kar EPO loop ki continuity measure karein; loop band hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Re-terminate loose EPO wiring and re-check before restarting the inverter.
solutions.ur: Dhili EPO wiring dobara laga dein aur inverter restart karne se pehle dobara check karein.

meaning.en: The inverter's IGBT device temperature is too high; output is cut.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke IGBT ka temperature bohat zyada hai; output band ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Heat sink and fans clogged with dust
causes.ur: Heat sink aur fans dhool se block hue hain

causes.en: Unit installed with no clearance on the cooling side
causes.ur: Cooling side par clearance na hone wala installation

causes.en: Overloading for long hours so the junction temperature keeps climbing
causes.ur: Bohat ghanton overloading, is liye junction temperature barhti rehti hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then clean the heat sink and all fans thoroughly.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke heat sink aur saare fans poori tarah saaf karein.

solutions.en: Check the NTC sensor on the heat sink with a meter; a drifted sensor gives wrong temperature.
solutions.ur: Meter se heat sink ka NTC sensor check karein; drift ho gayi sensor galat temperature deta hai.

solutions.en: Restore the manufacturer's clearance around the unit and reduce the load if the site is undersized.
solutions.ur: Manufacturer ki clearance wapas karein aur site chhoti ho to load kam karein.

meaning.en: Fan 1 is faulty; check whether the fan is running normally.
meaning.ur: Fan 1 kharab hai; check karein ke fan normally chal raha hai ya nahi.

causes.en: Fan 1 motor failed open circuit
causes.ur: Fan 1 ka motor open circuit ho gaya

causes.en: Fan 1 connector not seated after a service visit
causes.ur: Service ke baad Fan 1 ka connector baitha nahi hua

causes.en: Fan 1 tach output not detected by the control board
causes.ur: Control board fan 1 ka tach output detect nahi kar raha

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then check fan 1 spins freely and its connector is seated.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke check karein ke fan 1 azaad ghoomta hai aur connector baitha hai.

solutions.en: Replace fan 1 with an identical 12 V DC fan of the same frame size.
solutions.ur: Fan 1 ko wahi 12 V DC fan, same frame size, se replace karein.

solutions.en: If the new fan still trips code 66, have the board's fan drive and tach input checked.
solutions.ur: Naya fan lagane par bhi code 66 aaye to board ka fan drive aur tach input check karwayein.

meaning.en: The internal fan is faulty; check whether it is normal.
meaning.ur: Internal fan kharab hai; check karein ke yeh normal hai ya nahi.

causes.en: Internal fan packed with dust inside the cabinet
causes.ur: Cabinet ke andar dhool se internal fan pack ho gaya

causes.en: Internal fan motor bearing worn
causes.ur: Internal fan motor ka bearing ghis gaya

causes.en: Internal fan cable disconnected
causes.ur: Internal fan ka cable nikal gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery before opening the cabinet.
solutions.ur: Cabinet kholne se pehle AC, PV aur battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: Vacuum the internal fan and confirm it spins freely in both directions.
solutions.ur: Internal fan ko vacuum karein aur confirm karein ke dono taraf azaad ghoomta hai.

solutions.en: Replace the internal fan with the same part number if it does not spin or its cable is damaged.
solutions.ur: Internal fan na ghoome ya cable kharab ho to wahi part number ka fan lagayein.

meaning.en: There was an error writing to the EEPROM, so settings may be lost.
meaning.ur: EEPROM mein likhte waqt error aaya hai, is liye settings kho sakti hain.

causes.en: Power cut exactly while settings were being saved
causes.ur: Settings save hote waqt hi power cut ho gaya

causes.en: EEPROM chip failed after surge damage
causes.ur: Surge damage ke baad EEPROM chip kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Brown-out supply writing corrupted values
causes.ur: Brown-out supply se corrupt values likh diye gaye

solutions.en: Back up the current settings from the app before doing anything else.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi karne se pehle app se current settings ka backup bana lein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the battery, PV and grid, then power-cycle once and check if code 71 clears.
solutions.ur: Battery, PV aur grid disconnect karke aik baar power-cycle karein aur dekhein ke code 71 hatta ya nahi.

solutions.en: If code 71 stays, the EEPROM or the board must be replaced at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Code 71 bache to EEPROM ya board service centre par replace karna hoga.

notes.en: Do not accept the unit back to the customer until settings survive a power cycle, otherwise the customer loses configuration every outage.
notes.ur: Settings power cycle ke baad bhi na bache to customer ko unit wapas na dein, warna har outage par configuration chali jayegi.

meaning.en: The 12 V auxiliary power supply has failed, so the control board is not powered correctly.
meaning.ur: 12 V auxiliary power supply kharab ho gayi hai, is liye control board theek se power nahi le raha.

causes.en: Auxiliary transformer or SMPS failed
causes.ur: Auxiliary transformer ya SMPS kharab ho gaya

causes.en: 12 V auxiliary fuse blown
causes.ur: 12 V auxiliary fuse phoot gaya

causes.en: Relay coil or contactor shorting the 12 V rail
causes.ur: Relay coil ya contactor 12 V rail ko short kar raha hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then measure the 12 V rail on the control board with a meter.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke meter se control board par 12 V rail measure karein.

solutions.en: Check and replace the 12 V auxiliary fuse with the exact rating specified by Felicity.
solutions.ur: 12 V auxiliary fuse check karke Felicity ki di hui exact rating se replace karein.

solutions.en: If the fuse keeps blowing, disconnect the relay coils one by one to find the shorted device.
solutions.ur: Fuse baar baar phoote to relay coils ko aik aik karke disconnect karke short wala device dhoondein.

aliases: CT or Hall open circuit fault

title.en: Fault 73 CT or Hall sensor open circuit
title.ur: Fault 73 CT ya Hall sensor open circuit

meaning.en: The current sensing device is faulty; check the CT or Hall element connections.
meaning.ur: Current sensing device kharab hai; CT ya Hall element ke connections check karein.

causes.en: CT or Hall sensor connector unplugged during installation
causes.ur: Installation ke dauran CT ya Hall sensor ka connector nikal gaya

causes.en: Hall current sensor failed
causes.ur: Hall current sensor kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Smart meter CT not clipped fully onto the conductor
causes.ur: Smart meter ka CT conductor par poora clip nahi hua

solutions.en: Check that the CT or Hall connector is fully seated at both the sensor and the inverter end.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke CT ya Hall connector sensor aur inverter dono taraf poori tarah baitha hai.

solutions.en: Re-clip the CT so it closes fully around the single conductor, with the arrow pointing at the grid direction.
solutions.ur: CT ko dobara clip karein ke woh aik hi conductor ke gird poori tarah band ho, arrow grid ki taraf ho.

solutions.en: Compare the inverter's grid CT reading with a clamp meter; a zero reading with real export means replace the sensor.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se inverter ke grid CT ki reading compare karein; export hote hue bhi zero aaye to sensor replace karein.

aliases: Main and auxiliary DSP communication fault

meaning.en: There is an error in the DSP communication; the manual says to upgrade the software.
meaning.ur: DSP communication mein error hai; manual ke mutabiq software update karein.

causes.en: Firmware version mismatch after a partial update
causes.ur: Adhoora update hone se firmware version mismatch

causes.en: DSP ribbon cable or connector loose
causes.ur: DSP ka ribbon cable ya connector dhila hai

causes.en: Interference from a badly earthed motor or welding machine
causes.ur: Bade motor ya welding machine ki behti earth se interference

solutions.en: Update both the inverter and the BMS firmware to the same version using the app.
solutions.ur: App se inverter aur BMS dono ka firmware aik hi version par update karein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the DSP ribbon cable on the control board.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke control board par DSP ribbon cable dobara laga dein.

solutions.en: Separate earth the welding machine and noisy motors; a noisy earth corrupts the DSP link.
solutions.ur: Welding machine aur noisy motors ki alag earth karayein; shor wali earth DSP link kharab karti hai.

meaning.en: There is an error in the MCU communication; the manual says to upgrade the software.
meaning.ur: MCU communication mein error hai; manual ke mutabiq software update karein.

causes.en: Firmware version mismatch between parallel units
causes.ur: Parallel units ke darmiyan firmware version mismatch

causes.en: MCU reset loop from a noisy DC supply
causes.ur: Noisy DC supply se MCU reset loop mein chala gaya

causes.en: Control board MCU soldering failure
causes.ur: Control board ke MCU ki soldering fail ho gayi

solutions.en: Compare firmware versions of all units on the LCD and update every unit to the same version.
solutions.ur: LCD par sabhi units ke firmware versions compare karke sab ko aik hi version par update karein.

solutions.en: Check the 12 V auxiliary rail for ripple; excessive ripple resets the MCU.
solutions.ur: 12 V auxiliary rail par ripple check karein; zyada ripple MCU ko reset karta hai.

solutions.en: If a firmware update does not clear it, have the control board replaced at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Firmware update se hal na ho to service centre par control board replace karwayein.

meaning.en: The inverter's leakage current is too large; check the inverter wiring.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka leakage current bohat zyada hai; inverter wiring check karein.

causes.en: PV array insulation degraded through moisture or panel backsheet damage
causes.ur: Nami ya panel backsheet damage se PV array ki insulation kharab

causes.en: Cable insulation damaged by UV, heat or rodent bite
causes.ur: UV, garmi ya chuha ke kaatne se cable insulation kharab

causes.en: Leakage current sensor itself faulty
causes.ur: Leakage current sensor khud kharab hai

solutions.en: Isolate PV at the DC isolator, then measure each string's insulation to earth with a megohmmeter.
solutions.ur: DC isolator se PV isolate karke megohmmeter se har string ki earth insulation measure karein.

solutions.en: Split the array in halves and re-test to find which half leaks, then check those cables and connectors in the shade.
solutions.ur: Array ko do hisson mein baant kar dobara test karein taake pata chale kaunsa hissa leak kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Replace damaged cables, MC4 connectors or the affected panels; never tape over an insulation fault.
solutions.ur: Kharab cable, MC4 connector ya panel replace karein; insulation fault par tape mat lagayein.

meaning.en: The insulation of the PV string is abnormal; there is a leakage path to earth.
meaning.ur: PV string ki insulation theek nahi hai; earth tak leakage path hai.

causes.en: PV string shorted to the array frame through a damaged backsheet
causes.ur: Kharab backsheet se PV string array frame se short ho gaya

causes.en: Water inside a junction box or on a DC cable
causes.ur: Junction box ya DC cable par paani aa gaya

causes.en: Module laminate breakdown from a manufacturing defect
causes.ur: Manufacturing defect se module ka laminate break ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate PV at the DC isolator before any test; do not probe a live array.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi test karne se pehle DC isolator se PV isolate karein; live array par probe na karein.

solutions.en: Megohmmeter-test each string to earth, string by string, to find the leaking one.
solutions.ur: Megohmmeter se har string ko earth ke khilaf aik aik karke test karke leak wala dhoondein.

solutions.en: Open and dry the junction boxes, then re-test; replace any module whose insulation is still low.
solutions.ur: Junction boxes khol ke sukha dein, phir dobara test karein; ab bhi insulation kam ho to module replace karein.

meaning.en: Battery 1 insulation is abnormal; there is a leakage path from the battery.
meaning.ur: Battery 1 ki insulation theek nahi hai; battery se leakage path hai.

causes.en: Battery pack electrolyte leakage or condensation inside the pack
causes.ur: Battery pack mein electrolyte leakage ya condensation

causes.en: Battery cable chafed against the metal enclosure
causes.ur: Battery cable metal enclosure se ragad gaya

causes.en: BMS earth connection loose so the pack floats
causes.ur: BMS ki earth connection dhili hai, is liye pack float kar raha hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then megohmmeter-test the battery terminals to the pack chassis.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke megohmmeter se battery terminals ki pack chassis ke khilaf insulation test karein.

solutions.en: Inspect the battery cables along their whole route for chafing and move them away from metal edges.
solutions.ur: Battery cables ko poore raste par chafing ke liye dekhein aur metal edges se door rakhein.

solutions.en: Check the pack earth bolt torque; a loose pack earth makes the reading meaningless.
solutions.ur: Pack earth bolt ka torque check karein; dhili pack earth ki wajah se reading bekaar ho jati hai.

title.ur: Fault 83 Inverter ka relay open circuit

meaning.en: The inverter relay is not closing properly, causing an open circuit; shut down and restart.
meaning.ur: Inverter relay theek se close nahi ho raha, open circuit ho raha hai; band karke restart karein.

causes.en: Grid relay contacts burnt or pitted
causes.ur: Grid relay ke contacts jalay ya pitted hue hain

causes.en: Relay coil driver failed on the control board
causes.ur: Control board par relay coil driver kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Relay mechanical jam from dust or insect nest
causes.ur: Dhool ya keede ke ghar se relay mechanically jam ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then inspect the grid relay for pitting and burnt contacts.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke grid relay ke pitting aur jale contacts dekhein.

solutions.en: Replace the relay with the exact Felicity part number, including its DC coil voltage.
solutions.ur: Relay ko exact Felicity part number se replace karein, DC coil voltage bhi same rakh kar.

solutions.en: Clean out any insect nest or dust and check the relay arm is free to move after fitting the new relay.
solutions.ur: Keede ke ghar ya dhool saaf karein aur naya relay lagane ke baad relay arm azaad chalta hai ya nahi check karein.

aliases: Short circuit fault of inverter relay

meaning.en: The inverter relay is not disconnecting properly, causing a short circuit; shut down and restart.
meaning.ur: Inverter relay theek se disconnect nahi ho raha, short circuit ho raha hai; band karke restart karein.

causes.en: Grid relay contacts welded after an overcurrent event
causes.ur: Overcurrent event ke baad grid relay ke contacts weld ho gaye

causes.en: Relay assembly contaminated by dust that bridges the contacts
causes.ur: Relay assembly par dhool ki wajah se contacts ke darmiyan bridge ban gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then confirm the relay is open and check for welded contacts.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke confirm karein ke relay open hai aur welded contacts dekhein.

solutions.en: Replace the relay and clean the relay board area before fitting the new one.
solutions.ur: Relay replace karein aur naya lagane se pehle relay board ka area saaf karein.

solutions.en: Find why the relay saw an overcurrent (oversized load or output short) before re-energising.
solutions.ur: Dobara chalu karne se pehle dhoondein ke relay par overcurrent kyun aaya (bara load ya output short).

title.ur: Fault 87 Parallel CAN communication mein masla

meaning.en: The inverter is connected to abnormal parallel communication.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka parallel communication abnormal hai.

causes.en: Parallel CAN cable loose, not terminated with the supplied resistors
causes.ur: Parallel CAN cable dhili hai ya supplied resistors ke saath terminate nahi ki

causes.en: Different firmware versions on the parallel units
causes.ur: Parallel units par firmware versions alag hain

causes.en: CAN cable run alongside AC power cables without separation
causes.ur: CAN cable AC power cables ke saath bina alag ke chal raha hai

solutions.en: With power off, reseat every parallel CAN connector and confirm the termination resistors are fitted as per the manual.
solutions.ur: Power off karke saare parallel CAN connectors dobara laga dein aur confirm karein ke termination resistors manual ke mutabiq lage hain.

solutions.en: Update all units in the parallel bank to the same firmware version.
solutions.ur: Parallel bank ke saare units ko aik hi firmware version par update karein.

solutions.en: Keep CAN cables away from AC power runs or route them in a separate conduit to reject noise.
solutions.ur: CAN cables ko AC power runs se door rakhein ya alag conduit mein se guzarein taake noise reject ho.

meaning.en: The parallel host has disconnected from the system; check whether the host is normal.
meaning.ur: Parallel host system se disconnect ho gaya; check karein ke host normal hai ya nahi.

causes.en: Host unit switched off or lost its own AC supply
causes.ur: Host unit band ho gaya ya uska apna AC supply chala gaya

causes.en: Host unit itself reporting a different fault
causes.ur: Host unit khud koi doosra fault de raha hai

causes.en: CAN link between host and this unit intermittent
causes.ur: Host aur is unit ke darmiyan CAN link intermittent hai

solutions.en: Walk the parallel bank and read each unit's own fault code; fix the master error first.
solutions.ur: Parallel bank mein jaan kar har unit ka apna fault code padhein; pehle master ka error theek karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the host unit's AC supply and its ON/OFF switch are healthy.
solutions.ur: Host unit ki AC supply aur uska ON/OFF switch theek hai ya nahi confirm karein.

solutions.en: Reseat the CAN cable at both ends of the host link, then power-cycle the bank once.
solutions.ur: Host link ke dono sifar par CAN cable dobara laga dein, phir bank ko aik baar power-cycle karein.

meaning.en: PV current is too high; check the string current.
meaning.ur: PV ka current bohat zyada hai; string current check karein.

causes.en: More strings on an MPPT than the hardware channel is rated for
causes.ur: MPPT par us se zyada strings lagi hain jo hardware channel ke rated se upar hai

causes.en: Current sensor hardware fault reporting a false high
causes.ur: Current sensor ki hardware kharabi se jhooti high reading

causes.en: Mismatched parallel strings causing circulating current
causes.ur: Alag alag parallel strings ki wajah se circulating current

solutions.en: Clamp-meter each string and confirm no string exceeds the inverter's max input current.
solutions.ur: Har string par clamp meter lagayein aur confirm karein ke koi string inverter ke max input current se zyada nahi.

solutions.en: Reconfigure the MPPT string assignment in the app so each channel carries the correct string count.
solutions.ur: App mein MPPT string assignment dobara set karein taake har channel par sahi number ki strings hon.

solutions.en: If the current is genuinely within limits, have the PV current sensing hardware tested.
solutions.ur: Agar current waqai limit ke andar ho to PV current sensing hardware test karwayein.

meaning.en: BMS 1 is not communicating; check the BMS 1 communication cable.
meaning.ur: BMS 1 communicate nahi kar raha; BMS 1 communication cable check karein.

causes.en: BMS 1 CAN cable unplugged at the inverter or the pack
causes.ur: BMS 1 ka CAN cable inverter ya pack se nikal gaya

causes.en: Battery type set to lead-acid so the inverter never opens the BMS link
causes.ur: Battery type lead-acid set hai, is liye inverter BMS link kabhi nahi kholta

causes.en: Pack 1 BMS in sleep because it was never woken
causes.ur: Pack 1 ka BMS sleep mein hai kyunke use wake nahi kiya gaya

causes.en: Pack 1 power not present, so its BMS cannot answer
causes.ur: Pack 1 ki power mojood nahi, is liye uska BMS jawab nahi de sakta

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the BMS CAN cable at both the inverter port and the pack COMM port.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke BMS CAN cable inverter port aur pack COMM port dono par dobara laga dein.

solutions.en: Switch the battery type to lithium in the LCD/app and confirm a 'C' communication icon appears on the LCD.
solutions.ur: LCD/app mein battery type lithium par switch karein aur confirm karein ke LCD par 'C' communication icon aa gaya.

solutions.en: Confirm the pack 1 breaker is closed and its own SOC LED is lit before troubleshooting further.
solutions.ur: Aagey ke liye confirm karein ke pack 1 ka breaker band hai aur uska apna SOC LED jal raha hai.

title.ur: Fault 94 PV busbar tez over voltage

meaning.en: Bus voltage rose too fast and too high; shut down and restart.
meaning.ur: Bus voltage bohat tez aur zyada barh gaya; band karke restart karein.

causes.en: PV string voltage far above the inverter's PV input limit at cold start
causes.ur: Cold start par PV string voltage inverter ki PV input limit se kaafi upar

causes.en: Grid loss while PV was already at full output
causes.ur: Grid chala jab ke PV pehle se full output par tha

causes.en: PV input voltage monitoring fault
causes.ur: PV input voltage monitoring ki kharabi

solutions.en: Measure PV open-circuit voltage at the DC isolator and compare it with the max PV input voltage.
solutions.ur: DC isolator par PV ka open-circuit voltage measure karke max PV input voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of modules in series so the cold-start voltage stays under the limit.
solutions.ur: Series mein modules ki kami karein taake cold-start voltage limit ke neeche rahe.

solutions.en: If the measured voltage is normal, have the PV input surge suppression circuit inspected.
solutions.ur: Measured voltage normal ho to PV input surge suppression circuit ka muaina karwayein.
